name: Hindi business meeting — clear approval
transcript:
[00:00:05] Kapoor: Namaste. Aaj ki meeting mein aapka swagat hai.
[00:00:11] Priya: Namaste Kapoor ji. Thank you for this opportunity.
[00:00:16] Kapoor: Humne aapka proposal carefully padha. Bahut impressed hain.
[00:00:22] Priya: Bahut khushi hui yeh sun ke. Koi questions hain?
[00:00:28] Kapoor: Nahi, sab clear hai. Haan bilkul, aage badhte hain. Hum is partnership ke liye ready hain.
[00:00:36] Priya: Yeh sunke bahut achha laga. Kab se shuru karna chahenge?
[00:00:42] Kapoor: Agले mahine se shuru kar sakte hain. Contract is hafte sign kar lete hain. Aaj shaam tak legal team ko bhejta hoon documents.
[00:00:53] Priya: Perfect. Main aaj shaam tak implementation plan bhi bhej deti hoon.
[00:01:00] Kapoor: Bilkul theek hai. Yeh partnership dono companies ke liye bahut faydemand hogi.
[00:01:07] Priya: Main bhi yahi sochti hoon. Thank you Kapoor ji.

summary: Kapoor confirmed approval of the partnership proposal, expressing strong satisfaction.
Contract will be signed this week; implementation begins next month.
Priya will send the implementation plan by this evening.

action_items.task: Send contract documents to legal team
